name: Gradaly v4.0.1
title: Gradaly v4.0.1
notes:
### ✨ What's New in Gradaly v4.0.1
- **Rubric & Grading Data Integrity**: Deleting a question now strictly removes only that question across all grading JSON files (`gradings/*.json`, `solution_grading.json`, `rubric_chats.json`) without affecting other questions. Deleting a criterion within a question now automatically resets the grading for that specific question (`pending`) across all graded copies so outdated evaluations are never retained.
- **Clean `.gradaly` Archive Export & Import + SemVer Protection**: `.gradaly` project exports now strictly exclude AI chat history (`rubric_chats.json`) and export/import only active questions from `config.json` and their corresponding gradings. Added strict SemVer protection blocking imports from newer Gradaly versions while automatically migrating archives exported from older versions.
- **Instant Project List Refresh**: Importing a `.gradaly` archive now immediately updates the sidebar and welcome screen project lists without requiring an application restart.
- **AI Grading Reliability (Gemini & OpenRouter GLM-5.3 Flash)**: Added automatic multi-step fallback for Google Gemini (`gemini-3.8-flash`) when safety/recitation filters return an empty candidate, and tuned reasoning effort (`low`) and token budgets for OpenRouter `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` to prevent truncated JSON responses.
- **Linux AppImage & Ubuntu 22.04 Focus/Display Stability**: Enabled X11/XWayland fallback (`GDK_BACKEND=x11`), disabled WebKitGTK DMA-BUF compositing (`WEBKIT_DISABLE_COMPOSITING_MODE=1`), and suppressed `canberra-gtk-module` warnings on Linux to prevent window focus loss when switching from fullscreen terminals.
